newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia 97/98 C/A deficit seen $9.798 billion.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia 97/98 C/A deficit seen $9.798 billion.

text.p: Coordinating Minister for Economics and Finance Saleh Afiff said on Monday Indonesia's current account deficit was expected to be $9.798 billion in fiscal 1997/98 (April/March) or some 4.0 percent of its gross domestic product (GDP).
He said the current account deficit was expected to be $8.823 billion in 1996/97, or 4.0 percent of GDP.
"This deficit is quite big but it doesn't mean that it's not uncontrollable," Afiff told a budget briefing ahead of President Suharto's budget speech to parliament on Monday.
The minister said the deficit was due to the fast growing economy.
